postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU September 2025 Universal DataBase lists Suriname among countries which do not require postal codes, and its Suriname addressing sheet example contains no postcode. A shop ZIP field, district, resort, locality, AGID cell or draft synthetic planning code is not a SURPOST assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No postcode assignments exist to anchor postal Polygon or MultiPolygon records. District, resort, locality, neighbourhood, cadastral, address, route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi, raster, AGID planning-cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Use recipient, organization, street, house number, sublocality, city and country separately. District may be retained as independently typed context. Do not insert a fabricated postcode.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic identity and explicit relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. A district, locality, coordinate or synthetic SR code is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Draft SR planning cells may index separately authorized context but are never SURPOST codes or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The reviewed SURPOST site states all rights reserved and publishes no open postal dataset licence. UPU material is reference evidence only; no dataset redistribution or public-serving right is inferred.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO SR identity and its districts; do not merge Suriname with neighbouring jurisdictions or Dutch Caribbean territories.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-postcode finding is time-dependent. Retain retrieval time, edition, exact bytes and SHA-256 and re-check only after the pending-country sweep or an official announcement.

stages.definition: Suriname address-format inventory and draft synthetic planning material only.
Digest-bound UPU and SURPOST no-postcode, address-format, rights, identity and no-proxy evidence.

M2 requires a future current authoritative SURPOST or competent-public release establishing a Suriname postcode system and a complete finite denominator of every assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area postal object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Current UPU evidence places Suriname in the September 2025 list of countries not requiring postal codes and its Suriname address example contains no postcode; absence is represented as none and does not itself satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon milestone. Any future drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Districts, resorts, localities, neighbourhoods, addresses, routes, service areas, parcels, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells and synthetic SR planning codes are prohibited proxies. The approved immutable artifact must drive the real SR API/app, handle no-code/no-match/loading/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry states, fit and render translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear/re-search and display selected code, geometry kind, provenance class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: SR address metadata and no-postcode policy only; no real SR Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual SR loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Never manufacture a Suriname postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, address or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified.
